summary: Greenfire Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits including an amended and restated credit agreement for a C$275 million credit facility and a news release reporting annual general meeting (AGM) voting results. The credit agreement, dated December 19, 2025, involves the company as borrower with Bank of Montreal as agent and multiple co-lead arrangers. The filing does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a routine financing and corporate governance update.
